{{Top|leg}}
'''Iquazards''' were thick-skinned reptiles from [[Gelgelar/Legends|Gelgelar]]. They were hunted for food by the native [[Glarsaur]], as well as the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]] who lived at [[Krevk Settlement]].
